prompted_for: Black-on-white equipment drawing for the upgrades and retrofit service page (svc-upgrades), source for art/svc-upgrades.png and the Illustration component
composition: tall storage tank on braced legs dominant at left
framed pump skid at lower right
new pipe spool hanging from a chain hoist at upper centre, about to drop into the gap
short pipe run with valve already joining tank to skid
dashed alignment line showing where the spool will seat
layout_devices: suspended spool on a lifting sling as the focal action
dashed drop line indicating fit-up position
line_and_texture: bolt circles on every flange as small dots
motifs: vertical storage tank with manways and nozzles
pump skid in open frame with motors and control box
motion_implied: spool lowers along the dashed line and bolts into place
water then flows from tank to skid
t2i_keywords: black line art on white background
tall vertical storage tank on braced legs
pipe spool suspended from chain hoist
pipe being fitted into a gap
pump skid in open steel frame
t2i_prompt: Clean isometric line drawing, black lines on a pure white background, uniform stroke weight, no shading, no fill, no text, no people. An existing installation of <CONTENT>: a large vessel on one side and a framed machine skid on the other, joined by flanged pipework with valves, and one new flanged part suspended from a chain hoist on a sling, about to drop into a gap along a dashed alignment line. Precise bolt circles and fittings as clean outlines, generous white margin, suitable for tracing into a single-colour mask.
signature_idea: An upgrade caught mid-install: a new pipe spool hanging on a hoist above the gap it will fill between the existing tank and skid.
strengths: tells the retrofit story in one frame: existing plant plus a new part going in
dashed fit-up line is a clear, animatable device
real process equipment, credible to engineers
weaknesses: heavy flanged steel pipe and bolted tank read as stainless or carbon steel, not PP
many flanges and bolts make it busy
large flanged spool is closer to utilities plant than a PW skid
brand_fit_why: Recolourable precise line art with a strong idea, but the heavy flanged metalwork contradicts the polypropylene offer and the detail density fights the calm brand.
